newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah weakens on baht spillover.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah weakens on baht spillover.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah weakened against the dollar after strengthening at the opening following renewed pressure on the Thai baht, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said there was fresh pressure on the baht which immediately spilled over to the rupiah, sending the rupiah down to 2,570 at 0310 GMT from a high of 2,535.0.
The rupiah opened at 2,570/80 against the dollar.
"It's more of a spillover from Thai baht. The rupiah was on the way to recovery following calmer regional markets," he said.
Dealers said swap premiums also rose. Three-month swaps were taken at 65, up from 55 points and six-month rose to 120 from 110 points. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
